marketing_description: The Maytag Professional Series MVWP586GW Electric Top Load Washer features a 16 lb capacity and a stainless steel drum, making it suitable for medium to large-sized households. This washer includes an automatic balancing system and a durable 3-coat finish, ensuring smooth operation and long-lasting performance. With a 3.19 cu-ft cylinder volume and 106 L water consumption per cycle, it is designed to handle a variety of laundry needs.
